about_short_description.short_description: Mighty Health is a personal health coach that offers joint-friendly, low-impact workouts for healthy aging.

product.name: Mighty Health 12-Week Program
product.description: A 12-week health program offering personalized nutrition plans, joint-friendly exercises, and 1-on-1 coaching for adults 50+ to improve mobility, weight, and pain management.

product.name: Personalized Nutrition Plans
product.description: Customized nutrition plans with recipes and cooking classes tailored to support healthy aging and chronic condition management for adults 50+.

product.name: Joint-Friendly Exercise Library
product.description: A collection of over 250 low-impact, joint-friendly workouts designed to improve balance, strength, and mobility for older adults.

product.name: 1-on-1 Expert Care Team Coaching
product.description: Personalized coaching and support from a team of doctors, occupational therapists, and certified health coaches via video calls and text messaging.

product.name: Holistic Wellness Resources
product.description: Guidance and resources for improving sleep, reducing stress, and managing chronic conditions as part of a comprehensive health program for older adults.
